description: Painting services in Micanopy, FL: interior, exterior, cabinets, staining, washing, and color help for older homes and antique shops, done in the right order.

sections.h2: Where to start on an older Micanopy property
body: Owners of pre-war houses often tell us the same thing: everything needs something, and they do not know where to begin. The answer is almost always water first, looks second. Anything that lets moisture into the structure, such as open joints, soft trim, peeling sills, or a mildewed north wall, gets handled before cosmetic work indoors.
Our painting services in Micanopy, FL are designed to be planned together, so one crew lead looks at the whole property and helps you rank the work by urgency and budget.

bullets: 1. Clean the exterior and kill mildew with a gentle soft wash
2. Repair rot, re-caulk, and repaint the exterior shell, including windows and doors
3. Stain porches and decks that sit in shade and stay damp
5. Move inside: walls, ceilings, trim, then kitchen cabinets
body: Not every home follows that list exactly. A house with sound paint but a dark, dated kitchen may start with cabinets. The point is that the estimate lists each piece separately, so you can approve what makes sense now and schedule the rest.

For houses, we offer interior and exterior repainting, cabinet painting and refinishing, deck and fence staining, pressure washing and soft washing, drywall repair, wallpaper removal, ceiling painting and popcorn removal, and trim, door, and shutter painting. Older homes often benefit from detailed trim and molding work, since that is where many coats of old paint and the most character tend to live. For a fuller picture of whole-house work, see residential painting in Micanopy.

The antique shops and small commercial buildings downtown can get the same services, scheduled around operating hours, including nights and weekends. That covers storefront trim and doors, interior sales floors, masonry and stucco, and signage-area touch-ups. Details are on our Micanopy commercial painting page.

sections.h2: The same standards on every service
body: Whether it is one bedroom or a whole property, the approach does not change. Premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore products, named on the estimate. Two full coats as the baseline. Our own crews, with no subcontractors. A punch walk you sign, and fixes before the job closes. Exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, and touch-up paint stays with you. The full menu of what we do is on our services page.

faqs.q: Can I phase the work on my Micanopy home over several months?
faqs.a: Yes. Each surface and service is a separate line on the estimate, so you can approve the urgent work now and schedule the rest later.

faqs.q: Do you handle repairs as well as painting?
faqs.a: Prep includes rot and fascia replacement, nail pops, re-caulking, and spot-priming. Drywall repair, stucco repair, and wallpaper removal are also available.

faqs.q: Do you work on both homes and businesses in Micanopy?
faqs.a: Yes. We paint houses of every age as well as shops and commercial buildings, with commercial work scheduled around your hours.
